# USFinNexus

> Free U.S. educational finance calculators and source-based guides. No account required. Calculator inputs run in the browser; advertising and hosting data are disclosed in the Privacy Policy.

These optional discovery files are not an indexing or AI-citation guarantee. Examples are not loan offers, approvals, investment forecasts or tax returns. Download formats vary by tool.

## Sources and formulas

- [Methodology](https://usfinnexus.com/methodology): amortization, DTI, LTV, assumptions and limitations.
- [Privacy](https://usfinnexus.com/privacy)
- [Disclaimer](https://usfinnexus.com/disclaimer)
- [Mortgage market context](https://usfinnexus.com/mortgage-rates): source-dated Freddie Mac PMMS, not a lender quote.
- [IRS 2026 inflation adjustments](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-32.pdf)
- [HUD FHA MIP schedule](https://www.hud.gov/sites/dfiles/OCHCO/documents/2023-05hsgml.pdf)
- [VA funding fees](https://www.va.gov/housing-assistance/home-loans/funding-fee-and-closing-costs/)

M = P*r/(1-(1+r)^(-n)); at zero interest M=P/n. DTI=monthly debt/gross monthly income. LTV=loan/property value. Cap rate=annual operating income/purchase price. Cash-on-cash=annual cash flow/initial cash invested. Each tool discloses exclusions and user assumptions.

## Canonical U.S. calculator catalog

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/mortgage) — Estimate your monthly mortgage payment with principal, interest, property taxes, homeowners insurance, PMI and HOA fees. View amortization and extra-payment scenarios.
- [How Much House Can I Afford? Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/affordability) — Estimate how much house you can afford using income, recurring debt, down payment, mortgage rate, term and property-tax assumptions. Compare 28% and 43% planning scenarios.
- [Refinance Savings Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/refinance) — Use a mortgage refinance calculator to compare payment savings, refinance costs and break-even timing with your own rate, balance and fee assumptions.
- [Rent vs. Buy Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/rent-vs-buy) — Free rent vs buy calculator. Compare total 5-year costs, home equity, and break-even year. Uses real 2026 appreciation, tax benefits, and investment return data.
- [Closing Costs Calculator 2026](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/closing-costs) — Use this closing costs calculator to estimate lender charges, title and settlement fees, prepaid items, taxes and insurance for a home purchase.
- [Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/dti) — Calculate your debt-to-income ratio from recurring monthly debt and gross monthly income. Compare planning benchmarks without treating 43% as a universal mortgage approval limit.
- [Mortgage Amortization Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/amortization) — Generate a month-by-month mortgage amortization schedule showing principal, interest, remaining balance and the effect of extra principal payments.
- [Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/mortgage-payoff) — Model extra monthly principal and compare your original mortgage schedule with an accelerated payoff plan, including estimated time and interest saved.
- [ARM Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/arm) — Free ARM mortgage calculator. Instantly see your worst-case payment scenario, fully-indexed rate, and understand rate caps (5/6, 7/6 ARMs).
- [FHA vs. VA vs. USDA Loan Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/fha-va-usda) — Side-by-side comparison of FHA, VA, and USDA loan programs. See which government mortgage fits your budget with the lowest down payment and total cost.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/debt-payoff) — Compare debt snowball vs avalanche payoff methods across all your debts. See which strategy gets you debt-free fastest and saves the most interest. Free, no signup.
- [Budget Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/budget) — Plan your monthly budget using the 50/30/20 rule. See where your money goes across needs, wants, and savings. Free budget planner, no signup required.
- [2026 Federal Income Tax Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/income-tax) — Estimate 2026 U.S. federal income tax using official IRS tax brackets and standard deductions. Includes marginal rate, effective rate and an employee FICA estimate.
- [Down Payment Savings Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/down-payment) — Free down payment savings calculator. See how long to save 3.5%, 10%, or 20% down on your target home price. Set a monthly savings goal and track your timeline.
- [HELOC & Home Equity Line of Credit Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/heloc) — Calculate your HELOC payments, available equity, and total interest. See draw-period vs repayment-period costs instantly. Free, no signup required.
- [Auto Loan Calculator 2026](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/auto-loan) — Estimate a monthly car payment, total interest and loan amortization using vehicle price, down payment, trade-in, taxes, fees, APR and loan term.
- [Rental Property Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/rental-property) — Analyze rental property investments instantly. Calculate cash flow, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, and NOI for any US rental property. Free real estate investment calculator.
- [Side-by-Side Comparison](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/comparison) — Compare up to 3 mortgage loan scenarios side by side. Instantly see total interest, monthly payments, and lifetime costs across different rates, terms, and down payments.
- [Personal Loan Calculator 2026](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/personal-loan) — Free personal loan calculator for 2026. Estimate monthly payments, total interest, APR and payoff schedules for debt consolidation or other borrowing.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/retirement) — Calculate how much you need to retire comfortably and see if your savings are on track. Free retirement planner with compound growth projections and PDF export.
- [Investment Growth Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/investment) — Calculate investment growth with compound interest. See how regular contributions grow over time with interactive charts. Free investment calculator with PDF export.
- [Trump Account Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/trump-account) — Estimate how a Trump Account could grow from the federal $1,000 seed plus family or employer contributions. Free 2026 projection calculator.
- [FIRE Retirement Planner](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/fire-planner) — Calculate your FIRE number and early retirement timeline. Free financial independence calculator with safe withdrawal rate modeling and Coast FIRE analysis.
- [Mortgage Points Buy-Down Calculator 2026](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/points-buydown) — Free mortgage points calculator for 2026. Calculate if paying discount points upfront is worth it. See monthly savings and find your break-even point.
- [Interest-Only Loan Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/interest-only) — Calculate your interest-only mortgage payments and see exactly how much your payment will jump when the loan fully amortizes.
- [Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/student-loan) — Use this student loan payment calculator to estimate monthly payments, repayment term, payoff date, total interest and extra-payment scenarios.
- [Credit Card Debt Payoff Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/credit-card) — Use this credit card debt calculator to estimate payoff time, total interest and the effect of a larger fixed monthly payment or balance transfer.
- [DRIP Calculator: Dividend Reinvestment Growth](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/drip) — Calculate the compound growth of dividend reinvestment over time. Model dividend growth rates, yield on cost, and tax-adjusted returns. Free DRIP forecaster.
- [Crypto Tax Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/crypto-tax) — Estimate your 2026 cryptocurrency capital gains taxes. Calculate short-term vs long-term gains for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins under IRS rules. Free crypto tax estimator.
- [California Mortgage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/california) — Free California mortgage calculator. Includes Proposition 13 property tax protection, CA jumbo loan limits, and 2026 conforming limits for high-cost CA counties.
- [Texas Mortgage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/texas) — Free Texas mortgage calculator. Accounts for high TX property taxes (1.6%–2.5%), no state income tax savings, and homestead exemption. Built for Texas homebuyers.
- [Florida Mortgage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/florida) — Free Florida mortgage calculator. Factors in rapidly rising FL homeowners and flood insurance, no state income tax benefit, and 2026 Florida property tax rates.
- [FHA Mortgage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/fha) — Calculate your estimated FHA mortgage payment including the upfront and annual Mortgage Insurance Premium (MIP). Free FHA calculator with 3.5% down payment options.
- [VA Loan Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/va) — Calculate your VA loan monthly payment with 0% down. Automatically calculates the 2026 VA Funding Fee based on your military service and down payment.
- [Options Profit Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/options-profit) — Visualize your options trade before placing it. Calculate max profit, max loss, and break-even prices for calls, puts, and spreads. Free options profit calculator.
- [PMI Removal Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/pmi-removal) — Estimate when you can request PMI cancellation at 80% LTV and when it auto-terminates at 78%. Model extra payments. Free, no signup.
- [Temporary Buydown Calculator (2-1, 3-2-1 & 1-0)](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/temporary-buydown) — Model 1-0, 2-1, and 3-2-1 temporary buydowns. See year-by-year payments and the seller or builder subsidy needed. Free, no email.
- [Escrow Shortage Calculator](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/escrow-shortage) — See how an escrow shortage and higher taxes or insurance change your monthly payment. Compare lump-sum vs 12-month repayment. Free, no email.
- [How Much House Can I Afford by Salary?](https://usfinnexus.com/calculators/affordability/by-salary) — See estimated home-price ranges for common U.S. salaries in 2026. Adjust rate, down payment and debts, then open a salary-specific page.
